specialization.description: A Warrior's Physical abilities and a Mage's spells deal x(1 + maxBonus); an Adventurer gets x1 for both (content/specs.json).

spellMastery.description: Spells deal baseMultiplier x (1 + Arcana x perArcana) on top of Arcana's normal +8%: weak early, large late. Arcane's zero-to-hero curve.

weaponMastery.description: Weapon abilities deal baseMultiplier x (1 + Might x perMight) on top of Might's normal +8%: strong from the start and growing with Might, so Warriors keep up in the deep zones. Which spec has the edge late is set by each zone's resistances.
